panel.title: Advanced Git
panel.noRepository: No Git repository in this folder.

common.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and use Copy.

GIT_NOT_FOUND.title: Git was not found
GIT_NOT_FOUND.hint: Install Git on the host running Paseo and make sure it is on the daemon's PATH, then restart the daemon.

NOT_A_REPOSITORY.title: Not a Git repository
NOT_A_REPOSITORY.hint: The folder is not the top level of a Git work tree. It may have been moved or deleted; refresh the repository list.

INVALID_ARGUMENT.title: Invalid input
INVALID_ARGUMENT.hint: Check the name, path or value you entered and try again.

PATH_OUTSIDE_REPOSITORY.title: Path outside the repository
PATH_OUTSIDE_REPOSITORY.hint: Only files inside the repository can be used here.

REPOSITORY_BUSY.title: The repository is busy
REPOSITORY_BUSY.hint: Another operation on this repository took too long to finish. Wait for it, then try again.

INDEX_LOCKED.title: The index is locked
INDEX_LOCKED.hint: Another Git process may be running. If none is, remove the .git/index.lock file by hand; Advanced Git never deletes it.

TIMEOUT.title: Git took too long
TIMEOUT.hint: Git was stopped after its time limit. Check the network or the repository's size, then try again.

OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE.title: Too much output
OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE.hint: Git produced more output than Advanced Git reads. Narrow the request, for example with a filter.

AUTH_FAILED.title: Authentication failed
AUTH_FAILED.hint: Configure a credential helper or ssh-agent for Git on the host running Paseo. Advanced Git never asks for passwords or tokens.

HOST_KEY_VERIFICATION_FAILED.title: Host key verification failed
HOST_KEY_VERIFICATION_FAILED.hint: The remote's SSH host key is unknown or has changed. Verify it and add it to known_hosts on the host running Paseo.

NETWORK.title: The remote could not be reached
NETWORK.hint: Check the host's network connection and the remote's URL, then try again.

REMOTE_REJECTED.title: The remote rejected the push
REMOTE_REJECTED.hint: A hook or a protection rule on the remote refused it. Read Git's message below for the reason.

NON_FAST_FORWARD.title: The branch has diverged
NON_FAST_FORWARD.hint: The remote has commits you do not have. Pull (or sync) first, then push again.

NO_UPSTREAM.title: No upstream branch
NO_UPSTREAM.hint: This branch does not follow a remote branch. Publish it, or set its upstream.

NO_REMOTE.title: No remote
NO_REMOTE.hint: The repository has no remote of that name. Add a remote first.

MERGE_CONFLICT.title: Conflicts
MERGE_CONFLICT.hint: The operation stopped on conflicts. Resolve them in the Changes view, then continue or abort.

WOULD_OVERWRITE_CHANGES.title: Local changes are in the way
WOULD_OVERWRITE_CHANGES.hint: Commit or stash your changes first, or choose to stash them automatically.

UNMERGED_BRANCH.title: The branch is not merged
UNMERGED_BRANCH.hint: Deleting it would lose commits. Merge it first, or force the delete if the safety settings allow it.

REF_EXISTS.title: The name is already used
REF_EXISTS.hint: A branch, tag, remote or worktree of that name exists. Choose another name.

REF_NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
REF_NOT_FOUND.hint: The branch, tag, remote, stash or revision is no longer there. Refresh and try again.

NOTHING_TO_COMMIT.title: Nothing to commit
NOTHING_TO_COMMIT.hint: Stage some changes first, or commit all changes.

IDENTITY_MISSING.title: Your Git identity is not set
IDENTITY_MISSING.hint: Set user.name and user.email in Git's configuration on the host running Paseo.

OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS.title: An operation is in progress
OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS.hint: A merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert or bisect is under way. Continue or abort it first.

NO_OPERATION.title: No operation in progress
NO_OPERATION.hint: There is nothing to continue, skip or abort. Refresh the repository.

FORBIDDEN_BY_POLICY.title: Not allowed by the safety settings
FORBIDDEN_BY_POLICY.hint: Turn on “{{setting}}” in Advanced Git's safety settings for this host to allow it.

PROTECTED_BRANCH.title: Protected branch
PROTECTED_BRANCH.hint: The branch matches a protected-branch pattern in the safety settings, so this operation is refused.

CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.title: Confirmation required
CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.hint: This operation can lose work and must be confirmed. Try again and confirm it.

STALE_STATE.title: The repository changed
STALE_STATE.hint: Something changed since it was read. It has been read again; check and try again.

HOOK_FAILED.title: A Git hook failed
HOOK_FAILED.hint: A hook in the repository refused the operation. Read its message below and fix what it reports.

UNKNOWN.title: Git failed
UNKNOWN.hint: Read Git's message below. If it does not explain the problem, try the same command in a terminal.

host.offline: {{host}} is offline. Actions are disabled until it reconnects.
host.outcomeUnknown: The connection was lost before {{host}} answered. The operation may or may not have finished; the repository is being read again.
host.offlineAction: {{host}} is offline: this action is unavailable.
host.busyOther: Wait for the running operation to finish.

forcePush.noUpstream: The branch has no upstream to force push to.

settings.title: Advanced Git
settings.loadFailed: The settings could not be read.

safety.title: Safety
safety.info: These settings belong to this host. Advanced Git's daemon reads them before every destructive operation; they are all off by default.

allowForcePush.label: Allow force push
allowForcePush.hint: Push with --force-with-lease (never a bare --force) after a confirmation.
allowForcePush.warning: On: a force push can replace commits other people have pulled.

allowHardReset.label: Allow hard reset
allowHardReset.hint: Reset a branch with --hard after a confirmation.
allowHardReset.warning: On: a hard reset discards uncommitted changes in the work tree and the index.

allowForceDelete.label: Allow force delete
allowForceDelete.hint: Delete unmerged branches, remove worktrees with local changes, and clear all stashes.
allowForceDelete.warning: On: commits only reachable from a deleted branch, and dropped stashes, can be lost.

allowRemoteDelete.label: Allow deleting on remotes
allowRemoteDelete.hint: Delete branches and tags on a remote.
allowRemoteDelete.warning: On: deleting on a remote affects everyone who uses it.

protectedBranches.label: Protected branches
protectedBranches.hint: Branch patterns that are never force-pushed, deleted or hard-reset, whatever the switches above say. Separate them with commas; * matches within a segment, ** across segments.

safetySnapshots.label: Safety snapshots
safetySnapshots.hint: Before an operation that can discard tracked changes, record them under refs/advanced-git/snapshots so they can be restored.

view.title: View
view.info: These settings belong to this host: they apply to everyone using Advanced Git on it.

diffMode.label: Diff layout
diffMode.hint: Show diffs side by side or in one column.

diffWrap.label: Wrap long lines
diffWrap.hint: Wrap lines in diffs instead of scrolling sideways.

diffHideUnchanged.label: Collapse unchanged regions
diffHideUnchanged.hint: Fold long stretches of unchanged lines in diffs.

diffWhitespace.label: Whitespace
diffWhitespace.hint: Whether changes in leading and trailing whitespace count as changes.

syntaxHighlight.label: Syntax highlighting
syntaxHighlight.hint: Colour code in diffs by its language.

codeFontSize.label: Code font size
codeFontSize.hint: The size of code in diffs and blame.

graphScope.label: Graph shows
graphScope.hint: Which branches the commit graph shows by default.

autoFetch.label: Fetch automatically
autoFetch.hint: Fetch the selected repository in the background.

autoFetchMinutes.label: Fetch every
autoFetchMinutes.hint: How often the selected repository is fetched in the background.

confirmDiscard.label: Confirm before discarding
confirmDiscard.hint: Ask before discarding changes to files.

dateStyle.label: Dates
dateStyle.hint: Show commit dates as relative times or as dates.

gate.disabled: Turned off by “{{setting}}” in the safety settings.

reset.title: Reset {{branch}} to {{hash}}
reset.clean: No uncommitted changes to tracked files.

soft.label: Soft
soft.hint: Keep staged and unstaged changes; the changes of the commits that leave the branch become staged.

mixed.label: Mixed
mixed.hint: Keep every change in the work tree, unstaged, the changes of the commits that leave the branch included.

keep.label: Keep
keep.hint: Keep your uncommitted changes; stop if the reset would overwrite any of them.

hard.label: Hard
hard.hint: Discard staged and unstaged changes to tracked files. Untracked files are kept.

reset.hardBody: The branch moves to {{hash}} and every uncommitted change to a tracked file is discarded.
reset.doneSnapshot: Reset to {{hash}}. Your changes were saved as a safety snapshot ({{ref}}).

pick.noCommit: Do not commit: leave the result staged
pick.mainline: Parent to compare the merge with
pick.mainlineIntro: {{hash}} is a merge commit. Choose the parent whose side it keeps:

pick.conflicted: Stopped on conflicts. Resolve them in the Conflicts section, then continue or abort.

revert.body: Make commits that undo these, newest first:

operation.stoppedForEdit: Stopped for an edit: amend the commit if you wish, then continue.

operation.conflicts_other: {{count}} files are in conflict: resolve them, then continue.

operation.skipHint: Leave out the commit being applied

result.conflicted: Stopped on conflicts again. Resolve them, then continue.

merge.title: Abort the merge?
merge.body: The merge's result and every conflict resolution in the work tree and the index are discarded; the branch goes back to where it was before the merge.

rebase.title: Abort the rebase?
rebase.body: The commits replayed so far and every conflict resolution are discarded; the branch goes back to where it was before the rebase.

cherryPick.title: Abort the cherry-pick?
cherryPick.body: The commits picked so far and every conflict resolution are discarded; HEAD goes back to where it was before the cherry-pick.

revert.title: Abort the revert?
revert.body: The reverts made so far and every conflict resolution are discarded; HEAD goes back to where it was before the revert.

bisect.title: End the bisect?
bisect.body: The commits marked good and bad are forgotten, and HEAD goes back to where it was before the bisect.

am.title: Abort applying the patches?
am.body: The patches applied so far and every conflict resolution are discarded; the branch goes back to where it was before.

invalid.characters: A name cannot hold spaces, control characters or any of ~ ^ : ? * [ \
invalid.form: Not a valid name: no “..”, “@{” or “//”, no “/” or “.” at either end, no part starting with “.”, and no “.lock” at the end.

createDialog.title: Create a branch
createDialog.name: Branch name
createDialog.startPointHint: A branch, tag or commit. Leave it empty to start at the current HEAD.

switcher.title: Switch branch
switcher.hint: Press Enter to switch to the first branch listed.

checkoutDialog.dirtyTitle: Local changes are in the way
checkoutDialog.dirtyBody: Switching to {{ref}} would overwrite local changes. Advanced Git can stash them, switch, and apply them again.
checkoutDialog.stashConflict: Switched to {{ref}}, but applying your changes again conflicted. The stash is kept: resolve the conflicts in Changes.
checkoutDialog.detachedBody: This checks out {{ref}} without a branch (a detached HEAD). Commits made there belong to no branch until you create one.
checkoutDialog.remoteBody: Creates a local branch that tracks {{ref}} and switches to it. If a local branch of that name already tracks it, switches to that one.

mergeDialog.title: Merge {{ref}}
mergeDialog.ffHint: Git's default: moves the branch forward when it can, and creates a merge commit otherwise.
mergeDialog.noFfHint: Records the merge even when a fast-forward is possible.
mergeDialog.ffOnlyHint: Fails when a merge commit would be needed.
mergeDialog.squashHint: Stages the combined changes for a commit of your own; no merge is recorded.
mergeDialog.upToDate: {{current}} is already up to date with {{ref}}.
mergeDialog.squashed: Squashed {{ref}}: the changes are staged. Commit them to finish.
mergeDialog.conflict: Merging {{ref}} stopped on conflicts. Resolve them in Changes, then commit or abort the merge.

rebaseDialog.title: Rebase onto {{onto}}
rebaseDialog.body: Replays the commits of {{current}} that are not on {{onto}} on top of it. Those commits are rewritten: they get new hashes.
rebaseDialog.autostash: Stash local changes first and apply them again afterwards
rebaseDialog.publishedBody: Some of the commits being rewritten are on the upstream of {{current}}. Everyone who has them will have to reconcile, and pushing afterwards needs a force push.
rebaseDialog.publishedConfirm: Rewrite commits that are already pushed
rebaseDialog.conflict: The rebase stopped on conflicts. Resolve them in Changes, then continue or abort it.

deleteDialog.title: Delete branch {{name}}?
deleteDialog.body: Deletes the local branch {{name}}. Its commits stay on every other branch that holds them.
deleteDialog.unmergedBody: {{name}} is not merged: some of its commits are on no other branch. Force deleting it makes them unreachable.
deleteDialog.lostCommits: The commits only {{name}} holds (they become unreachable)

upstreamDialog.title: Set the upstream of {{name}}
upstreamDialog.empty: No remote branch matches. Fetch or add a remote first.

remote.title: Remotes

addDialog.urlHint: No password or token in the URL: Git signs in with the host's credential helper or SSH keys.

urlDialog.title: Edit the URL of {{name}}
urlDialog.push: Set the push URL rather than the fetch URL

removeDialog.title: Remove remote {{name}}?
removeDialog.body: Removes {{name}} from this repository's configuration, with its remote-tracking branches and the upstream settings that name it. Nothing changes on the remote itself.

deleteBranchDialog.title: Delete {{branch}} on {{remote}}?

stateHint.clean: At the commit its parent records.

updateDialog.body: Checks out in each submodule the commit its parent records. Local changes in a submodule make the update fail rather than be lost.
updateDialog.remote: Move to the tip of the tracked branch instead

rebase.title: Interactive Rebase
rebase.empty: There are no commits after this one in the current branch.
rebase.intro_one: Rewrite the commit after {{base}}. Commits are listed oldest first.
rebase.intro_other: Rewrite the {{count}} commits after {{base}}. Commits are listed oldest first.

actionHint.reword: Use the commit with a new message
actionHint.edit: Stop at the commit to amend it
actionHint.squash: Fold into the commit before, keeping both messages
actionHint.fixup: Fold into the commit before, keeping only its message

problem.firstFolds: The first kept commit cannot be squashed or fixed up: there is no commit before it to fold into.
problem.emptyMessage: A reworded commit needs a message.

rebase.pushed: Some of these commits are already on the upstream. Rewriting them rewrites published history: everyone who pulled them will have to recover.
rebase.pushedAck: I understand that this rewrites published history
rebase.pushedHint: The upstream already has this commit
rebase.merges: The range holds merge commits. A rebase leaves them out and flattens the history.
rebase.truncated: More than {{count}} commits: too many to rebase here.
rebase.autostashHint: Restores them when the rebase ends (git rebase --autostash).
rebase.stale: The branch changed since the commits were read. They have been read again: check the plan and start again.
rebase.conflict: The rebase stopped on conflicts. Resolve them, then continue or abort.
rebase.stopped: The rebase stopped at a commit to edit. Amend it, then continue.

snapshots.title: Safety Snapshots
snapshots.intro: Before an operation that can discard changes to tracked files, Advanced Git records them here. Restoring applies a snapshot's changes to the work tree and keeps the snapshot.
